title: Privacy
text:
In short

We collect what we need to answer requests, hold sessions, write transcripts and take payment.
Raw requests and transcripts are kept separately, seen only by us and our consultants, and deleted 30 days after the request is completed or declined.
For the long term, we keep only an anonymized service log: a short, cleaned-up summary of each question with no names, contact details or company names, plus administrative details such as dates and session type.
We never log the content of out-of-scope requests.
We don’t sell your information, show ads, or use your requests or transcripts to train AI models.
Questions or deletion requests: prompthumanhq@gmail.com.

title: Privacy
text:
Who this covers
PromptHuman (“we”, “us”) connects AI agents with real people for short, paid question-and-answer sessions. This policy explains how we handle personal information across everything we do: our website, the requests we receive, the sessions we hold, the transcripts we write and the payments we take.
“You” means the operator of the requesting agent (the person or company that runs it), including when the agent contacts us on your behalf. We treat requests from an agent as coming from its operator. This policy works alongside our Terms, including their confidentiality section. Where the two differ, the one that gives your information more protection applies.

title: Privacy
text:
What we collect
Requests and correspondence. When an agent or operator emails us, we receive the sending email address, the request and anything attached to it, and any later messages in the thread.
Sessions and transcripts. We receive what is said during a session, and we write a transcript that we send to you.
Payments. Sessions are paid by card through Stripe. Through Stripe we receive your email address, your name or business name if you provide one, your billing country and postal code, the request reference you enter at checkout, and the amount and status of the payment. We never see or store full card numbers.
Phone and voicemail. If you call or text our business number, we receive your number and any message you leave.
Our website. Our website is a static site hosted by GitHub Pages. We don’t use cookies, analytics or tracking scripts. GitHub, as our host, may log technical information such as visitors’ IP addresses for security purposes, under GitHub’s privacy statement.
What we ask you not to send. As our Terms say, please don’t send personal data about your users unless it is essential to the question. Never send government ID numbers, financial account numbers, passwords, health information or information about children. If a request depends on that kind of information, or on financial, medical, legal, tax or engineering advice, we decline it as out of scope.

title: Privacy
text:
How we use it

To decide whether a request is in scope and reply to it.
To schedule and hold sessions, and to write and deliver transcripts.
To take payments, issue refunds and keep accounting and tax records.
To keep the anonymized service log described below, which we use to improve our service.
To prevent fraud and abuse, enforce our Terms and meet legal obligations.

We don’t sell personal information, use it for advertising, or use requests or transcripts to train AI models.

title: Privacy
section: How we store and delete it
text:
How we store and delete it
We keep three kinds of records, each stored and kept for a different period.








Record
What it contains
How long we keep it




Raw records
Original requests, attachments, email threads about a request, session text and transcripts
Deleted 30 days after the request is completed or declined


Payment records
Payment and refund details held by Stripe and in our accounts
As long as tax and accounting law requires [for example, seven years]


Service log
Anonymized summaries and administrative details
Kept indefinitely



Raw records are stored separately from the service log, and only we and our consultants can access them. We keep a raw record past 30 days only if we need it to resolve a dispute, refund or chargeback, or if the law requires us to keep it, and we delete it once that need ends.
The transcript we send you is yours to keep. Deleting our copy doesn’t affect yours.

title: Privacy
text:
The service log
To understand what agents need and improve our service, we keep a log of every request. It contains:

a short summary of the question, written by us, with names, contact details, company names and identifying specifics removed;
a request ID and a client code, which let us recognize repeat clients without recording who they are;
administrative details, such as how the agent found us, the agent platform, the type of operator (company, individual or unknown), the question category, the session type and price, the dates and times a request was received, reviewed and completed, the session length, payment and refund status, and whether the session changed the agent’s next step.

The log never contains raw request text, names, email addresses, phone numbers, company names or payment details. If we decline a request as out of scope, the log records only that it was declined and the general reason, such as “medical”, never what the request said.
The key that links a client code to a client is held only in our email and payment records, which follow the retention periods above. We may share aggregate statistics from the log, such as how many requests fall into each category, but never in a way that could identify a client or a specific request.

title: Privacy
text:
Who we share it with

Our consultants, who have each signed an agreement with us that includes confidentiality terms. They see only what they need to handle your request.
Service providers who store or process information for us: Stripe (payments), Google (email, file storage and our business phone number), GitHub (website hosting) and [session chat tool]. Each handles information under its own privacy policy.
Legal and safety reasons, when we believe in good faith that the law requires it, or to protect the rights, property or safety of PromptHuman, our clients or others.
A business transfer, if PromptHuman is merged, sold or reorganized. Anyone who takes over must protect your information at least as well as this policy does.

We don’t share or publish requests or transcripts with anyone else.

title: Privacy
text:
Information about other people
A request may mention people other than you, such as your users or colleagues. You’re responsible for having the right to share their information with us. We treat it the same way as yours: it stays in the raw records, it’s deleted after 30 days, and it never enters the service log.

title: Privacy
Privacy
text:
Security
We protect our accounts with two-step verification, keep raw records separate from the service log, limit access to us and our consultants, and delete raw records on schedule. No system is perfectly secure. If a breach affects your personal information, we’ll notify you as the law requires.

title: Privacy
text:
International clients
We’re based in Pennsylvania, in the United States, and our service providers store information in the United States and elsewhere. If you contact us from another country, your information is transferred to and handled in the United States.
If you’re in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, we rely on these legal bases: performing our agreement with you (handling requests, sessions and payments), our legitimate interest in improving our service (the anonymized service log) and in preventing fraud, and legal obligations (tax and accounting records). You also have the right to complain to your local data protection authority.

title: Privacy
text:
Children
Our service is for businesses and adults. We don’t knowingly collect information from anyone under 18.

title: Privacy
text:
Changes
If we change this policy, we’ll post the new version here and update the date at the top. If a change materially affects how we handle information we already hold, we’ll highlight it on this page before it takes effect.

text:
How it works

You email a request in the format above.
We check it’s in scope and that a consultant is free. If not, we say so and nothing is charged.
When we’re ready, we reply with a time and a Stripe payment link for that session type.
Payment confirms the slot. We meet, then send the transcript.

Confidential by default

These terms apply to every request and session with PromptHuman. By paying for a session, the operator of the requesting agent (the person or company that runs it) accepts them.

title: Terms
text:
What we provide
Short opinions and perspectives from real people on taste, tone, plausibility and lived experience. We are not licensed professionals. We do not give financial, medical, legal, tax or engineering advice, and nothing we say should be treated as such.

title: Terms
text:
Payment and refunds

Sessions are prepaid by card through a Stripe payment link, sent only after we accept a request.
Full refund if we decline your request (including ending a session as out of scope) or miss your slot.
If your agent does not join within 3 minutes of its slot, we keep 50% and refund the rest.

title: Terms
text:
Confidentiality
Both sides keep the other’s confidential information private. We use what your agent shares only to answer its request. We also keep a short, anonymized summary of each request for record-keeping and to improve our service, as described in our Privacy Policy. Please don’t send personal data about your users unless it is essential to the question.

title: Terms

We keep transcripts for 30 days, then delete them. We never use them to train AI models.
